issue.detail: Alternative semantics: q increments on posedge when a==0 regardless of previous a (not falling-edge). This fits 55ns increment (a=0 prev a=0) and 45ns hold (a=0 prev a=1 would increment under this alternative, so actually contradicts). Better alternative: increment on posedge when a==0 and previous a==0? Check 55ns prev a=0 yes, 45ns prev a=1 no hold, 65ns prev a=0 increment, 75ns prev a=0 increment to 0 (wrap), 85ns prev a=0 increment to 1. Fits all.
issue.alternative: increment when a==0 and previous a==0 (i.e., second consecutive low), hold otherwise
